title: The effect of COVID-19 on completed suicide rate in Iran: an Interrupted Time Series study (ITS).
authors: Nouhi Siahroudi A, Hashemi Nazari SS, Namdari M, Panahi MH, Mahdavi SA, Khademi A.
figures: Sample data set for the study to be called in R-Studio software for discontinuous time series analysis

ITS plot of standardized incidence of suicide deaths in IRAN from March 2009 to 20,223 compared to the counterfactual level (circles = observed rates; red line = modeled rates fitted to the data; blue line = counterfactual level. Gray area = Announcement of mental health orientation following the COVID-19 pandemic by the WHO).

Seasonally adjusted ITS plot of standardized incidence of suicide deaths in IRAN from March 2009 to 2023. Circles = observed rates; red line = modeled rates fitted to the data (step change only); blue line = modeled rates fitted to the data (multiplicative interaction). Gray area = Announcement of mental health orientation following the COVID-19 pandemic by the WHO.
